meta.titulo: Used Porsche 992 for sale · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 911 type 992, from 2019, inspected on 111 points with a twelve-month warranty. Carrera, S, GTS, Turbo and GT3, with certified mileage.

parrafos: The 992 is the current 911: 3.0 twin-turbo with 385 hp in the Carrera, 450 in the S and 480 in the GTS, eight-speed PDK, wide body on every version and a digital interior. The Turbo S reaches 650 hp and the GT3 keeps the naturally aspirated 4.0 with 510 hp. From 2024 the second series adds the Carrera GTS with the T-Hybrid system.
Buying a used 992 means buying an almost new car for considerably less than a new one, with no waiting list. The difference lies in the options and in how much warranty is left.

secciones.titulo: What we check on a 992 before selling it
items: Factory and Porsche Approved warranty: how much remains and on what terms it transfers.
Service history within the Porsche network and service campaigns carried out.
Electronics and software: PCM, driver assistance, sensors and pending updates.
PDK, brakes (PCCB if fitted), tyres and wheels: condition, dates and damage.
Full specification: options, packages and match with the Porsche certificate.

parrafos: Every Porsche 992 we sell goes through our 111-point inspection, leaves with a twelve-month or 10,000 km warranty on engine and gearbox, and its certified mileage is stated on the sales invoice. We have been Porsche specialists since 1979, with our own workshops in Barcelona and Madrid: the car you buy here has been on our lift before it reaches your hands.
If you have found the one you want elsewhere, we can also check it for you before you pay for it: pre-purchase inspection.
